name: MCW Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: MCW's top championship, first awarded at the fed's own debut pay-per-view and left vacant seven months later when its holder turned on the promotion on air; a battle royal crowned its next champion the following January.

name: MCW North American Championship
notes: Retired by the fed 28 January 2007 with no further reign; the fed's own Title History document does not say why.
epitaph: A secondary title decided by an eight-man tournament at MCW's own debut pay-per-view and retired outright a little over seven months later, with no second reign ever recorded.

name: MCW Legend
notes: The fed's own Title History document describes this as "a special championship belt presented on a special occasion" rather than a standing, defended title.
epitaph: A one-off belt MCW's own Title History document calls "a special championship belt presented on a special occasion," contested in a single sixty-minute Ironman match that ended in a draw, with both competitors awarded the title.

name: Michael Hegstrand Cup
notes: The fed's own Title History document labels this a "Tag Team Tournament" trophy rather than a defended championship.
epitaph: A tag team tournament trophy MCW's own Title History document names for Michael Hegstrand, first awarded to New & Improved D-X after a four-team bracket in the fed's own final months.

name: Missouri Champion
notes: The fed's own Title History document (last edited 29 January 2007) states this regional title was "Never Awarded."
epitaph: MCW's own designated "Main Regional Title," left unawarded through the whole of the fed's Title History document's own record.
